scenario_text: A company is rewriting its payroll system to move it from an old batch-type mainframe to a distributed mini-computer/PC-based networked setup. No new functionality will be added. The statement of work calls for a conversion "as is." Only the input and output subsystems will be altered for the new environment. Since it is a payroll application, testing and verification will be emphasised within the development activities. The schedule allows five months for the project, with two people working on it.

requirements.statement: The system shall be compatible with the new distributed mini-computer/PC-based networked setup
requirements.business_justification: To ensure seamless transition from old mainframe to new networked setup
requirements.assumptions: The new networked setup will be properly configured and maintained
requirements.acceptance_criteria: The system runs without errors on the new networked setup

requirements.statement: The system shall maintain existing payroll functionality without adding new features
requirements.business_justification: To ensure continuity of payroll processing without disrupting business operations
requirements.assumptions: The existing payroll functionality is well-documented and understood
requirements.acceptance_criteria: The system processes payroll data correctly and accurately

requirements.statement: The system shall only modify the input and output subsystems for the new environment
requirements.business_justification: To minimize changes to existing code and reduce risk of introducing new errors
requirements.assumptions: The input and output subsystems are well-defined and separable from the rest of the system
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Only the input and output subsystems have been modified

requirements.statement: The system shall undergo thorough testing and verification to ensure accuracy and reliability
requirements.business_justification: To ensure the system meets the required standards for payroll processing
requirements.assumptions: A comprehensive testing plan has been developed and executed
requirements.acceptance_criteria: The system passes all testing and verification criteria

controls.title: Integrations authenticated, encrypted and rate-limited
controls.proposed_requirement: Every integration with an external system shall be mutually authenticated, encrypted in transit, allow-listed and rate-limited, with failures logged.

controls.title: Sensitive data encrypted at rest and in transit
controls.proposed_requirement: The system shall encrypt customer and transaction data at rest and in transit using algorithms and key lengths approved under the bank's cryptographic policy.
controls.reference: RBI Cyber Security Framework 2016, Annex 1 para 8.1; IT Governance Direction 2023, para 16

source.citation: Cyber Security Framework in Banks §8.1 (RBI/2015-16/418) [2016 framework (partly superseded by the 2023 IT directions)]
source.title: Cyber Security Framework in Banks
source.version: 2016 framework (partly superseded by the 2023 IT directions)
source.excerpt:
8.1 Provide secure access to the bank’s assets/services from within/outside bank’s 
network by protecting data/information at rest (e.g. using encryption, if supported by 
the device) and in -transit (e.g. using technologies such as VPN or other secure web 
protocols, etc.)

controls.title: Security events monitored and alerted on
controls.proposed_requirement: The system shall forward security events to the bank's security operations monitoring and raise alerts on anomalous access or activity.
controls.reference: RBI Cyber Security Framework 2016 — continuous surveillance / SOC

source.citation: Cyber Security Framework in Banks §19.6(b) (RBI/2015-16/418) [2016 framework (partly superseded by the 2023 IT directions)]

controls.title: Vulnerability management, patching and security testing before release
controls.proposed_requirement: The system shall undergo vulnerability assessment and penetration testing before go-live and after major changes, and its components shall be patched under the bank's patch management policy.
controls.reference: RBI Cyber Security Framework 2016, Annex 1 para 7

source.citation: Cyber Security Framework in Banks §7.1 (RBI/2015-16/418) [2016 framework (partly superseded by the 2023 IT directions)]
source.title: Cyber Security Framework in Banks

risk_register.title: High-risk function depends on an external system (REQ-001)
risk_register.cause: REQ-001 is high risk and classified Integration: The system shall be compatible with the new distributed mini-computer/PC-based networked setup
risk_register.consequence: An external system's availability, contract or interface change blocks a high-risk function.
risk_register.mitigation: Agree interface contracts early, stub the dependency for testing, and define fallback behaviour.

risk_register.title: Legacy migration — undocumented behaviour and data conversion
risk_register.cause: The problem statement says: "A company is rewriting its payroll system to move it from an old batch-type mainframe to a distributed mini-computer/PC-based networked setup."
risk_register.consequence: Behaviour the old system relied on is lost or data is converted wrongly.
risk_register.mitigation: Inventory existing behaviour, reconcile migrated data, and run old and new in parallel before cut-over.
evidence: A company is rewriting its payroll system to move it from an old batch-type mainframe to a distributed mini-computer/PC-based networked setup.
